title: Pixel Switch
description: A switch whose knob carries a dot icon: on change the dots scatter and re-form, and a lit arc sweeps the rim.
usage: For one or two settings per view that deserve a moment: theme, sound, notifications, power. Four icon pairs ship in MAPS inside pixel-switch.js (theme, sound, bell, power); edit a pair or add one, then name it in data-pxs. The control is a native checkbox, so read it on change: for the theme pair, set document.documentElement.dataset.theme from input.checked. After setting checked from script, dispatch a change event so the icon follows. For a list of settings, use Switch.
a11y: A native checkbox with role="switch" covers the whole part: Tab focuses it, Space toggles it, and assistive technology reads its name from aria-label (or a visible label) and its on/off state from the checkbox. Keyboard focus draws the shared --k-ring around the track. The dots, rim and glow are aria-hidden decoration; in Chromium the icon measured at least 6.9:1 against the knob and the 1px rim at least 3.6:1 against the page in both themes. Under prefers-reduced-motion or a zero motion multiplier the icon and knob change without animation. Without JavaScript the switch still toggles and reports its state; the knob shows no icon.
